derived_status_rule: A goal is unlocked only when every dependency has a current independently verified pass receipt for the exact strategy/data/configuration hashes; otherwise locked. Receipts are evidence, not authority to send financial orders.

goals.title: Attest safe paper-only environment
goals.unlock_when: Operator has authorised simulation-only work (2026-10-29); no real-money permission.
acceptance: Official pinned Freqtrade build starts on existing qualified host.
Exchange data is accessible without credentialed trading.
Dry-run true; spot only; no withdrawals, derivatives, margin, leverage, or live order connector.
Logs, restart, stop and restricted network/service boundaries demonstrated.
No second orchestrator or personal data committed to repo.

goals.title: Acquire and verify market data and naive baselines
goals.unlock_when: FT-00 receipt is independently verified and current.
acceptance: Timestamped reproducible market-data snapshot for two liquid spot instruments, quote currency actually supported by exchange.
Gaps, timezones, stale candles, traded volumes, rates and transaction-cost assumptions documented.
Cash, buy-and-hold and one pre-registered simple trend strategy baseline generated on same dates.

goals.title: Audit backtest validity and freeze evaluation protocol
goals.unlock_when: FT-01 receipt is current and data verification passes.
acceptance: Chronological train/validation/untouched holdout or walk-forward protocol committed before viewing test outcomes.
Freqtrade lookahead-analysis and recursive-analysis run with findings recorded.
Fees, spread, slippage and adverse 2x cost sensitivity included; no final-candle future leakage.
Metrics include net return, benchmark excess return, max drawdown, exposure, trades, volatility, Sharpe where sample adequate, and test count.
goals.failed_gate: No strategy promotion until bias and reproducibility defects closed.

goals.title: Evaluate a bounded candidate strategy
goals.unlock_when: FT-02 verified and strategy search budget precommitted.
acceptance: At most three interpretable strategy families explored in first pass: trend, breakout, mean reversion; avoid unlimited optimisation.
All candidate trials logged, including rejected configurations and dataset windows.
One candidate is selected using validation only; holdout evaluated once with pre-registered pass/fail conditions.
Candidate must improve on relevant benchmarks after stressed costs without intolerable drawdown; otherwise record no-edge verdict.
LLM proposes hypotheses but has no exchange execution permission.
goals.failed_gate: If no advantage, stop or reformulate within new registered experiment; do not cherry-pick.

goals.title: Run unattended forward paper execution and health checks
goals.unlock_when: FT-03 shows a reproducible acceptable candidate and verified simulation-only config.
acceptance: Dry-run verified for minimum 30 consecutive days; no real order destination or exchange trading credentials.
Order/fill simulations, missed fills, errors, clock skew, network interruptions and fees recorded.
Daily stop/health monitor works and automatically disables simulated orders on data or integrity failure.
Performance compared with cash/buy-hold and selected baseline on matched period.
goals.failed_gate: On outage, corrupted data or unexpected execution, lock and restart evidence window when necessary.

goals.title: Independently assess forward evidence and economic viability
goals.unlock_when: FT-04 has current logs and independent verification.
acceptance: Prefer >=90 calendar days of forward observations and >=50 closed paper trades before drawing a trade-statistical claim; otherwise verdict insufficient evidence, not pass.
Analyse net excess return after conservative costs, drawdown, tail losses, operating time and inference/compute expenses.
Compare to precommitted benchmarks and account for tested-strategy multiplicity.
Independent adversarial review recommends stop, revise or continued simulation; do not equate profits with statistically proven alpha.
goals.failed_gate: Insufficient evidence or failed review cannot automatically unlock monetisation.

goals.title: Human-only monetisation review (live execution excluded)
goals.unlock_when: FT-05 independent review is satisfactory AND operator explicitly approves a separate capital/risk/legal policy review.
acceptance: Produce written decision on affordability, capital at risk, exchange access, regulation, taxation and security.
Request new explicit operator authorisation for any future real-money implementation.
Existing Misumi finance framework remains binding; this programme never enables live execution.
goals.failed_gate: Remain research/paper-only; zero financial orders permitted.
